title: Orbit of fixed-width binary increment
statement: Let $Q,r$ be natural numbers with $r<2^Q$. Starting from the length-$Q$ all-zero word, apply fixed-width little-endian binary increment $r$ times, treating overflow as leaving the word unchanged. The resulting word is the length-$Q$ little-endian binary representation of $r$.
